feeds.title: Bruce Percy Blog
feeds.description: Bruce Percy is a landscape and travel photographer based in Scotland. Follow his blog for photographic stories from around the world.

feeds.title: On Landscape
feeds.description: On Landscape is a bi-weekly magazine dedicated to landscape photography from romantic to contemporary. We're all community and we'll feature photographs by all of our readers. There is great photography being created everywhere and we want to be one of the best curated galleries to find new talent.

feeds.title: David Gibbeson Photography Blog
feeds.description: David Gibbeson is an outdoor, travel and landscape photographer based in Devon. He enjoys taking photos of the landscapes and coastline of the South West of England and beyond.

feeds.title: Bruce Percy Colourchrome Blog
feeds.description: I'm Bruce. I was born in 1967 to Scottish parents. I live in Edinburgh, Scotland. I've always been drawn to the arts: drawing and painting as a kid, music composition as a teenager and photography as an adult. I don't like to pre-visualise a place. It's best to just go and see what the landscape offers. Read more about my photography journey, destinations, gear reviews and more!

feeds.title: James Lane Blog
feeds.description: I'm James. I turned to photography as this was something I could do on my own, gave me purpose to being in the landscape and gave me an excuse to travel to amazing places, even if I had no one to go with. In my blog posts I like to keep you up-to-date with the new locations I visit for landscape photography, as well as the current gear I am using.

feeds.title: Pete Rowbottom Landscape Photography Blog
feeds.description: Blog on Photography matters. I'm Pete. The Highlands of Scotland had captured my imagination on my very first visit in the 1980s, where I'd also seen these grand panoramic landscape images for sale that just blew me away, quite simply, I wanted to be able to do that too. Many hours of endless (but very enjoyable) learning ensued and I discovered a real passion for shooting landscape and architecture which I was able to combine with my love of the outdoors, travel, walking, and exploring remote locations.

feeds.title: Julian Baird Photography Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to The Exposed Blog where every week you'll find a new post or video about my latest landscape photography adventure from Dartmoor, Devon, Cornwall and beyond. You'll also find some tips on landscape photography and how to print your photographs at home.

feeds.title: Nigel Danson Blog
feeds.description: I'm Nigel. My passion is taking photos of landscapes and I have been fortunate enough to travel to many fantastic places - with my all time favorite being Iceland. I find it so rewarding when you get that picture that captures the weather, or the ever changing state of the environment. Read more about my photography journey, reviews and more!

feeds.title: Justin Minns Photography Blog
feeds.description: A blog by Justin Minns about life as a landscape photographer including news, reviews, new work and general thoughts. Justin Minns is an award-winning professional landscape photographer based in East Anglia.

feeds.title: Isle Of Harris Artist Margaret Soraya
feeds.description: I'm Margaret. I am a landscape photography retreat leader and have been a professional photographer for 17 years. Sharing, teaching, and helping you in your photographic journey is my great passion. In my blog, you will find information about how I plan workshops, the photographic kit I use and how to get to various places.

feeds.title: Brad Carr Photography Blog
feeds.description: I'm Brad Carr. I am Landscape & Nature Photographer following the seasons. Read more about my photography journey, destinations, gear reviews, and more!

feeds.title: Sussex Photo Blog
feeds.description: Amateur Landscape Photographer based in Hastings East Sussex. Love the health benefits of getting outdoors regularly with a camera, both mentally and physically. Read more about my photography journey, destinations, gear reviews, and more!

feeds.title: Tristan Campbell Photography Blog
feeds.description: Tristan Campbell is a landscape photographer and website developer based in Harrogate, North Yorkshire. Have a look at the Evocative landscape and seascape photography from Tristan Campbell on his Absolutely Nothing photoblog

feeds.title: James Bell Photography Blog
feeds.description: Lake District landscape photography prints by local photographer, James Bell. Bestselling pictures include Buttermere Tree, The Retreat and Coniston Shore.

feeds.title: Nigel Waters Photography Blog
feeds.description: Photography Blog Posts, Landscape, Seascape and Nature by UK Landscape Photographer Nigel Waters. Informative post and inspiration to explore nature.

feeds.title: James Grant Photography Blog
feeds.description: James Grant is a full-time professional landscape photographer mainly based in the Peak District but works UK wide.

feeds.title: Richard Fox Photography Blog
feeds.description: I'm Richard. In the last 11 years, after moving down to Devon, living on the outskirts of Dartmoor, I have spent a lot of my spare time mountain biking and road cycling. I started photographing landscapes in 2012 when I made a risky purchase of a full frame DSLR camera (Digital Single-Lens Reflex). My drive to take better images started here. Read more about my photography journey, destinations, gear reviews and more!

feeds.title: Melvin Nicholson Photography
feeds.description: My name is Melvin Nicholson and I am a UK based professional photographer.I live, breathe and sleep landscape photography and to be able to share my passion, enthusiasm and knowledge with others is for me, a dream come true. In my blog, I aim to inspire you to learn photography through my tutorials, tips interviews, and stories.

feeds.title: Nature TTL » Landscape
feeds.description: Read a selection of Landscape photography tutorials written by professional photographers.

feeds.title: Daniel Wretham Photography Blog
feeds.description: Dorset based landscape photographer Daniel Wretham presents a collection of breathtaking images from all over the U.K. Get hints & tips to get your best landscape pictures.

feeds.title: Marie Gardiner Blog
feeds.description: Writer & photographer based in NE England. My partner and I also make documentaries as part of Lonely Tower Film & Media, working closely with lovely people to help tell some amazing stories. My photography mostly involves landscapes and ruins, so I can usually be found exploring new places and looking for adventure, though it usually finds me.

feeds.title: Tim Dove Photography Blog
feeds.description: My name is Tim Dove and I'm a landscape photographer based in South Cumbria and a stone's throw away from the Lake District National Park. Welcome to my blog and news section. I've always loved the stories that accompany images, I believe it further brings them to life. I also like to offer as much guidance and help to aspiring photographers as I can with the knowledge I've built up over the last 5-6 years. Please stay tuned as I document all my latest adventures in photography.

feeds.title: Landscape Photography & Snowdonia Workshops by Simon Kitchin Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the website of landscape photographer Simon Kitchin, author of the photo location guidebook PHOTOGRAPHING NORTH WALES. As a photographer based in North Wales many of my landscape photographs are taken within the Snowdonia National Park and along the Isle of Anglesey Coastal Path, although whenever I get the chance I do take the opportunity to travel further afield.
